title: Minnesota Litigation Tracker — CMS Deferral Lawsuit
supports: The Minnesota Attorney General's current litigation tracker identifies the CMS Deferral Lawsuit as filed March 2, 2026 to challenge the $243 million Medicaid deferral component at issue in the suit.
The tracker records the status as the district court having denied the preliminary injunction motion.
The litigation remains listed on the Attorney General's active federal litigation tracker as of retrieval on August 29, 2026.
important_qualifications: This status page is the plaintiff state's litigation tracker, not an independent federal-court docket determination of every current deadline or filing.

The full February 25 CMS deferral was $259,505,491; Minnesota's federal suit challenged the approximately $243.8 million program-integrity component rather than the separate approximately $15.4 million immigration-status component.
The tracker does not establish final disposition of the administrative deferral or final allowability of the questioned Medicaid claims.
